2	Option Explicit
3	
4	' ============================================================
5	' DeduplicateEncounters.bas
6	'
7	' Implements Section 2 (steps 3-8) of
8	' docs/FC_Completion_Report_Process_Flow_for_Review.md for File A
9	' (FC Summary Report), after FilterFileA's mode/cancellation cleaning:
10	'
11	'   GetFCStatusPriority   -- Step 3: priority order table (1 = best)
12	'   AddPriorityColumn     -- writes a "PRIORITISE" column using the table above
13	'   MarkDuplicateEncounters -- Step 5 (visual aid): highlight duplicate
14	'                              Encounter Numbers in red. Call this BEFORE
15	'                              ResolveDuplicateEncounters if you want a
16	'                              before-snapshot, since resolution deletes the
17	'                              losing rows.
18	'   ResolveDuplicateEncounters -- Steps 6-8: for each Encounter Number with
19	'                              more than one row, automatically picks the row
20	'                              to keep and deletes the rest. Also counts
21	'                              encounters whose only row is Voided/Deleted
22	'                              (priority 99) for the "please double-check"
23	'                              report -- these single rows are NOT deleted.
24	'
25	' Q2-Q4 from the process flow doc were confirmed 2026-06-18, then revised
26	' 2026-07-29 against "Guide to monthly processing of report 3.docx" (the
27	' authoritative source, which the process flow doc had silently diverged
28	' from): priority 99 now means Voided/Deleted only (Decision 2), and the
29	' Inflight exception (Q3) was narrowed (Decision 4) -- it only overrides the
30	' plain "lowest priority wins" rule when a non-Inflight ED/EDFC-created row is
31	' in the group AND the resulting winner has priority <= 2. Driven by the
32	' Config "Staff Name -> Team" roster (Helpers.LoadStaffRoster) -- with an
33	' empty/unfilled roster everyone is "Others", so the exception never fires and
34	' the algorithm reduces to "lowest priority wins, tie-break by largest FC ID".
35	' ============================================================
36	
37	' ---- Step 3: FC Status priority order -----------------------------------------
38	'
39	' Lower number = better outcome = row to keep when an encounter has duplicates.
40	'
41	' Decision 2 (2026-07-29 conflict resolution): priority 99 is reserved for
42	' Voided/Deleted ONLY, matched via case-insensitive substring ("VOID" / "DELET")
43	' so wording variants (e.g. "Voided", "Deleted by Admin") are still caught.
44	' Everything else that isn't one of the six explicit statuses below -- Draft
45	' variants, blanks, typos, brand-new eFC statuses -- is priority 98 ("not
46	' completed" but NOT excluded from the denominator the way 99 is). Callers
47	' that need to surface unrecognised status text (for the Summary sheet warning
48	' block) should compare the input status against this function's Case list
49	' themselves; this function only returns the priority number.
50	Public Function GetFCStatusPriority(fcStatus As String) As Long
51	    Dim s As String
52	    s = UCase(NormalizeDashesAndSpaces(fcStatus))
53	
54	    If InStr(s, "VOID") > 0 Or InStr(s, "DELET") > 0 Then
55	        GetFCStatusPriority = 99
56	        Exit Function
57	    End If
58	
59	    Select Case s
60	        Case "COMPLETED"
61	            GetFCStatusPriority = 1
62	        Case "ACKNOWLEDGEMENT BY OTHER MEANS"
63	            GetFCStatusPriority = 2
64	        Case "ATTEMPTED - VIRTUAL FC COMPLETED, PENDING SIGNATURE"
65	            GetFCStatusPriority = 3
66	        Case "ATTEMPTED - PATIENT/NOK DECLINES TO SIGN"
67	            GetFCStatusPriority = 4
68	        Case "ATTEMPTED - PATIENT IS UNABLE TO SIGN"
69	            GetFCStatusPriority = 5
70	        Case "ATTEMPTED - UNABLE TO COMPLETE"
71	            GetFCStatusPriority = 6
72	        Case Else
73	            GetFCStatusPriority = 98   ' Draft variants, blanks, typos, new statuses -- NOT excluded from denominator
74	    End Select
75	End Function
76	
77	' Adds a "PRIORITISE" column as the last column, populated via
78	' GetFCStatusPriority for every data row. Lets staff see at a glance why the
79	' tool kept or dropped a given row.
80	Public Sub AddPriorityColumn(ws As Worksheet)
81	
82	    Dim fcStatusCol As Long
83	    fcStatusCol = FindColByHeader(ws, "FC Status")
84	    If fcStatusCol = 0 Then Exit Sub
85	
86	    Dim encCol As Long
87	    encCol = FindEncounterCol(ws)
88	
89	    Dim lastRow As Long, lastCol As Long
90	    If encCol > 0 Then
91	        lastRow = ws.Cells(ws.Rows.Count, encCol).End(xlUp).Row
92	    Else
93	        lastRow = ws.Cells(ws.Rows.Count, fcStatusCol).End(xlUp).Row
94	    End If
95	    If lastRow < 2 Then Exit Sub
96	    lastCol = ws.Cells(1, ws.Columns.Count).End(xlToLeft).Column
97	
98	    Dim priCol As Long
99	    priCol = lastCol + 1
100	    ws.Cells(1, priCol).Value = "PRIORITISE"
101	
102	    Application.ScreenUpdating = False
103	
104	    Dim statusData As Variant
105	    statusData = ws.Range(ws.Cells(2, fcStatusCol), ws.Cells(lastRow, fcStatusCol)).Value
106	
107	    Dim priData() As Variant
108	    ReDim priData(1 To lastRow - 1, 1 To 1)
109	
110	    Dim i As Long
111	    For i = 1 To lastRow - 1
112	        If lastRow = 2 Then
113	            priData(i, 1) = GetFCStatusPriority(CStr(statusData))
114	        Else
115	            priData(i, 1) = GetFCStatusPriority(CStr(statusData(i, 1)))
116	        End If
117	    Next i
118	
119	    ws.Range(ws.Cells(2, priCol), ws.Cells(lastRow, priCol)).Value = priData
120	
121	    Application.ScreenUpdating = True
122	
123	End Sub
124	
125	' ---- Step 5: highlight duplicate Encounter Numbers (visual aid) -----------------------------------------
126	'
127	' Applies red fill + white font to every row whose Encounter Number appears
128	' more than once. Purely cosmetic -- does not change row order or count.
129	Public Sub MarkDuplicateEncounters(ws As Worksheet)
130	
131	    Dim encCol As Long
132	    encCol = FindEncounterCol(ws)
133	    If encCol = 0 Then Exit Sub
134	
135	    Dim lastRow As Long
136	    lastRow = ws.Cells(ws.Rows.Count, encCol).End(xlUp).Row
137	    If lastRow < 3 Then Exit Sub   ' need at least 2 data rows for a duplicate
138	
139	    Application.ScreenUpdating = False
140	
141	    Dim encData As Variant
142	    encData = ws.Range(ws.Cells(2, encCol), ws.Cells(lastRow, encCol)).Value
143	
144	    Dim counts As Object
145	    Set counts = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary")
146	    counts.CompareMode = vbTextCompare
147	
148	    Dim i As Long
149	    Dim key As String
150	    For i = 1 To UBound(encData, 1)
151	        key = Trim(CStr(encData(i, 1)))
152	        If counts.Exists(key) Then
153	            counts(key) = counts(key) + 1
154	        Else
155	            counts(key) = 1
156	        End If
157	    Next i
158	
159	    Dim dupRange As Range
160	    For i = 1 To UBound(encData, 1)
161	        key = Trim(CStr(encData(i, 1)))
162	        If counts(key) > 1 Then
163	            If dupRange Is Nothing Then
164	                Set dupRange = ws.Rows(i + 1)
165	            Else
166	                Set dupRange = Union(dupRange, ws.Rows(i + 1))
167	            End If
168	        End If
169	    Next i
170	
171	    If Not dupRange Is Nothing Then
172	        dupRange.Interior.Color = RGB(255, 0, 0)
173	        dupRange.Font.Color = RGB(255, 255, 255)
174	    End If
175	
176	    Application.ScreenUpdating = True
177	
178	End Sub
179	
180	' ---- Steps 6-8: automatic duplicate resolution -----------------------------------------
181	'
182	' For each Encounter Number with more than one row:
183	'   1. Compute the "plain" winner across ALL candidates: lowest
184	'      GetFCStatusPriority wins, ties broken by the larger FC ID (assumed to
185	'      be the more recently created one).
186	'   2. The narrow Inflight exception (Decision 4, 2026-07-29 conflict
187	'      resolution) only overrides the plain winner when BOTH hold:
188	'      a) at least one non-Inflight candidate in the group was created by an
189	'         ED/EDFC staff member (per the Config roster), AND
190	'      b) the winner that would result from setting Inflight rows aside has
191	'         priority <= 2 (i.e. Completed / Acknowledgement by other means).
192	'      When both hold, Inflight-created rows are set aside and the winner is
193	'      recomputed from the remaining (non-Inflight) candidates. Otherwise the
194	'      plain winner from step 1 stands -- this replaces the old, broader rule
195	'      that set Inflight rows aside whenever ANY non-Inflight row survived.
196	'   3. The winner is kept; every other row for that encounter is deleted.
197	'
198	' For each Encounter Number with exactly one row, that row is always kept --
199	' even if its priority is 99 (Voided/Deleted) -- but it is counted in
200	' voidedOnlyCount so MainMacro/BuildOutput can report it separately and
201	' exclude it from the denominator (per Q4).
202	'
203	' roster: Dictionary from Helpers.LoadStaffRoster (Staff Name -> Team).
204	'
205	' Returns False (and shows a MsgBox) if a required column is missing.
206	' On success, voidedOnlyCount, duplicateGroupsResolved, rowsRemoved,
207	' inflightExceptionApplied and inflightExceptionBlocked are filled in for the
208	' final summary dialog and the Methodology sheet.
209	Public Function ResolveDuplicateEncounters(ws As Worksheet, roster As Object, _
210	        ByRef voidedOnlyCount As Long, ByRef duplicateGroupsResolved As Long, _
211	        ByRef rowsRemoved As Long, ByRef inflightExceptionApplied As Long, _
212	        ByRef inflightExceptionBlocked As Long) As Boolean
213	
214	    On Error GoTo ErrHandler
215	
216	    voidedOnlyCount = 0
217	    duplicateGroupsResolved = 0
218	    rowsRemoved = 0
219	    inflightExceptionApplied = 0
220	    inflightExceptionBlocked = 0
221	
222	    Dim encCol As Long, fcIdCol As Long, fcStatusCol As Long, createdByCol As Long
223	    encCol = FindEncounterCol(ws)
224	    fcIdCol = FindColByHeader(ws, "FC ID")
225	    fcStatusCol = FindColByHeader(ws, "FC Status")
226	    createdByCol = FindColByHeader(ws, "FC Created By")
227	
228	    If encCol = 0 Or fcIdCol = 0 Or fcStatusCol = 0 Then
229	        MsgBox "Error: File A is missing one of 'Encounter Number', 'FC ID', or 'FC Status'." & vbNewLine & _
230	               "Check the FC Summary Report export.", vbExclamation, "Missing Column"
231	        ResolveDuplicateEncounters = False
232	        Exit Function
233	    End If
234	    ResolveDuplicateEncounters = True
235	
236	    Dim lastRow As Long, lastCol As Long
237	    lastRow = ws.Cells(ws.Rows.Count, encCol).End(xlUp).Row
238	    If lastRow < 2 Then Exit Function
239	    lastCol = ws.Cells(1, ws.Columns.Count).End(xlToLeft).Column
240	
241	    Application.ScreenUpdating = False
242	    Application.Calculation = xlCalculationManual
243	
244	    Dim allData As Variant
245	    allData = ws.Range(ws.Cells(1, 1), ws.Cells(lastRow, lastCol)).Value
246	
247	    ' --- Group data row indices (2..lastRow) by Encounter Number ---
248	    Dim groups As Object
249	    Set groups = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary")
250	    groups.CompareMode = vbTextCompare
251	
252	    Dim i As Long
253	    Dim encVal As String
254	    For i = 2 To lastRow
255	        encVal = Trim(CStr(allData(i, encCol)))
256	        If Not groups.Exists(encVal) Then groups.Add encVal, New Collection
257	        groups(encVal).Add i
258	    Next i
259	
260	    ' --- Decide which rows to keep ---
261	    Dim keepFlag() As Boolean
262	    ReDim keepFlag(1 To lastRow)
263	    keepFlag(1) = True   ' header row
264	
265	    Dim k As Variant
266	    For Each k In groups.Keys
267	        Dim grp As Collection
268	        Set grp = groups(k)
269	
270	        If grp.Count = 1 Then
271	            Dim soloIdx As Long
272	            soloIdx = grp(1)
273	            keepFlag(soloIdx) = True
274	            If GetFCStatusPriority(CStr(allData(soloIdx, fcStatusCol))) = 99 Then
275	                voidedOnlyCount = voidedOnlyCount + 1
276	            End If
277	        Else
278	            Dim n As Long
279	            n = grp.Count
280	
281	            Dim candidates() As Long
282	            ReDim candidates(1 To n)
283	            Dim idx As Long
284	            For idx = 1 To n
285	                candidates(idx) = grp(idx)
286	            Next idx
287	
288	            ' Classify each candidate's creator team, and note whether any
289	            ' non-Inflight candidate was created by ED/EDFC (Decision 4 guard a).
290	            Dim isInflight() As Boolean
291	            ReDim isInflight(1 To n)
292	            Dim inflightCount As Long
293	            inflightCount = 0
294	            Dim hasNonInflightED As Boolean
295	            hasNonInflightED = False
296	            For idx = 1 To n
297	                Dim createdBy As String
298	                createdBy = ""
299	                If createdByCol > 0 Then createdBy = CStr(allData(candidates(idx), createdByCol))
300	                Dim createdByTeam As String
301	                createdByTeam = GetStaffTeam(roster, createdBy)
302	                If createdByTeam = TEAM_INFLIGHT Then
303	                    isInflight(idx) = True
304	                    inflightCount = inflightCount + 1
305	                ElseIf createdByTeam = TEAM_ED_EDFC Then
306	                    hasNonInflightED = True
307	                End If
308	            Next idx
309	
310	            ' Step 1: plain winner across ALL candidates (lowest priority,
311	            ' tie-break larger FC ID). This is the fallback whenever the
312	            ' narrow Inflight exception doesn't apply.
313	            Dim plainWinnerIdx As Long, plainWinnerPriority As Long
314	            Dim plainWinnerFCID As Variant
315	            Dim rowI As Long, pr As Long
316	            plainWinnerIdx = 0
317	            For idx = 1 To n
318	                rowI = candidates(idx)
319	                pr = GetFCStatusPriority(CStr(allData(rowI, fcStatusCol)))
320	                If plainWinnerIdx = 0 Then
321	                    plainWinnerIdx = idx
322	                    plainWinnerPriority = pr
323	                    plainWinnerFCID = allData(rowI, fcIdCol)
324	                ElseIf pr < plainWinnerPriority Then
325	                    plainWinnerIdx = idx
326	                    plainWinnerPriority = pr
327	                    plainWinnerFCID = allData(rowI, fcIdCol)
328	                ElseIf pr = plainWinnerPriority Then
329	                    If CompareFCID(allData(rowI, fcIdCol), plainWinnerFCID) > 0 Then
330	                        plainWinnerIdx = idx
331	                        plainWinnerFCID = allData(rowI, fcIdCol)
332	                    End If
333	                End If
334	            Next idx
335	
336	            ' Step 2: consider the narrow Inflight exception (Decision 4).
337	            ' Guard (a): there is an Inflight row AND a non-Inflight candidate
338	            ' remains AND that non-Inflight side includes an ED/EDFC creator.
339	            Dim exceptionGuardA As Boolean
340	            exceptionGuardA = (inflightCount > 0 And inflightCount < n And hasNonInflightED)
341	
342	            Dim winnerIdx As Long
343	            winnerIdx = plainWinnerIdx
344	
345	            If exceptionGuardA Then
346	                ' Winner among non-Inflight candidates only.
347	                Dim excWinnerIdx As Long, excWinnerPriority As Long
348	                Dim excWinnerFCID As Variant
349	                excWinnerIdx = 0
350	                For idx = 1 To n
351	                    If Not isInflight(idx) Then
352	                        rowI = candidates(idx)
353	                        pr = GetFCStatusPriority(CStr(allData(rowI, fcStatusCol)))
354	                        If excWinnerIdx = 0 Then
355	                            excWinnerIdx = idx
356	                            excWinnerPriority = pr
357	                            excWinnerFCID = allData(rowI, fcIdCol)
358	                        ElseIf pr < excWinnerPriority Then
359	                            excWinnerIdx = idx
360	                            excWinnerPriority = pr
361	                            excWinnerFCID = allData(rowI, fcIdCol)
362	                        ElseIf pr = excWinnerPriority Then
363	                            If CompareFCID(allData(rowI, fcIdCol), excWinnerFCID) > 0 Then
364	                                excWinnerIdx = idx
365	                                excWinnerFCID = allData(rowI, fcIdCol)
366	                            End If
367	                        End If
368	                    End If
369	                Next idx

Attribute VB_Name = "DeduplicateEncounters"
Option Explicit

' ============================================================
' DeduplicateEncounters.bas
'
' Implements Section 2 (steps 3-8) of
' docs/FC_Completion_Report_Process_Flow_for_Review.md for File A
' (FC Summary Report), after FilterFileA's mode/cancellation cleaning:
'
'   GetFCStatusPriority   -- Step 3: priority order table (1 = best)
'   AddPriorityColumn     -- writes a "PRIORITISE" column using the table above
'   MarkDuplicateEncounters -- Step 5 (visual aid): highlight duplicate
'                              Encounter Numbers in red. Call this BEFORE
'                              ResolveDuplicateEncounters if you want a
'                              before-snapshot, since resolution deletes the
'                              losing rows.
'   ResolveDuplicateEncounters -- Steps 6-8: for each Encounter Number with
'                              more than one row, automatically picks the row
'                              to keep and deletes the rest. Also counts
'                              encounters whose only row is Voided/Deleted
'                              (priority 99) for the "please double-check"
'                              report -- these single rows are NOT deleted.
'
' Q2-Q4 from the process flow doc were confirmed 2026-06-18, then revised
' 2026-07-29 against "Guide to monthly processing of report 3.docx" (the
' authoritative source, which the process flow doc had silently diverged
' from): priority 99 now means Voided/Deleted only (Decision 2), and the
' Inflight exception (Q3) was narrowed (Decision 4) -- it only overrides the
' plain "lowest priority wins" rule when a non-Inflight ED/EDFC-created row is
' in the group AND the resulting winner has priority <= 2. Driven by the
' Config "Staff Name -> Team" roster (Helpers.LoadStaffRoster) -- with an
' empty/unfilled roster everyone is "Others", so the exception never fires and
' the algorithm reduces to "lowest priority wins, tie-break by largest FC ID".
' ============================================================

' ---- Step 3: FC Status priority order -----------------------------------------
'
' Lower number = better outcome = row to keep when an encounter has duplicates.
'
' Decision 2 (2026-07-29 conflict resolution): priority 99 is reserved for
' Voided/Deleted ONLY, matched via case-insensitive substring ("VOID" / "DELET")
' so wording variants (e.g. "Voided", "Deleted by Admin") are still caught.
' Everything else that isn't one of the six explicit statuses below -- Draft
' variants, blanks, typos, brand-new eFC statuses -- is priority 98 ("not
' completed" but NOT excluded from the denominator the way 99 is). Callers
' that need to surface unrecognised status text (for the Summary sheet warning
' block) should compare the input status against this function's Case list
' themselves; this function only returns the priority number.
Public Function GetFCStatusPriority(fcStatus As String) As Long
    Dim s As String
    s = UCase(NormalizeDashesAndSpaces(fcStatus))

    If InStr(s, "VOID") > 0 Or InStr(s, "DELET") > 0 Then
        GetFCStatusPriority = 99
        Exit Function
    End If

    Select Case s
        Case "COMPLETED"
            GetFCStatusPriority = 1
        Case "ACKNOWLEDGEMENT BY OTHER MEANS"
            GetFCStatusPriority = 2
        Case "ATTEMPTED - VIRTUAL FC COMPLETED, PENDING SIGNATURE"
            GetFCStatusPriority = 3
        Case "ATTEMPTED - PATIENT/NOK DECLINES TO SIGN"
            GetFCStatusPriority = 4
        Case "ATTEMPTED - PATIENT IS UNABLE TO SIGN"
            GetFCStatusPriority = 5
        Case "ATTEMPTED - UNABLE TO COMPLETE"
            GetFCStatusPriority = 6
        Case Else
            GetFCStatusPriority = 98   ' Draft variants, blanks, typos, new statuses -- NOT excluded from denominator
    End Select
End Function

' Adds a "PRIORITISE" column as the last column, populated via
' GetFCStatusPriority for every data row. Lets staff see at a glance why the
' tool kept or dropped a given row.
Public Sub AddPriorityColumn(ws As Worksheet)

    Dim fcStatusCol As Long
    fcStatusCol = FindColByHeader(ws, "FC Status")
    If fcStatusCol = 0 Then Exit Sub

    Dim encCol As Long
    encCol = FindEncounterCol(ws)

    Dim lastRow As Long, lastCol As Long
    If encCol > 0 Then
        lastRow = ws.Cells(ws.Rows.Count, encCol).End(xlUp).Row
    Else
        lastRow = ws.Cells(ws.Rows.Count, fcStatusCol).End(xlUp).Row
    End If
    If lastRow < 2 Then Exit Sub
    lastCol = ws.Cells(1, ws.Columns.Count).End(xlToLeft).Column

    Dim priCol As Long
    priCol = lastCol + 1
    ws.Cells(1, priCol).Value = "PRIORITISE"

    Application.ScreenUpdating = False

    Dim statusData As Variant
    statusData = ws.Range(ws.Cells(2, fcStatusCol), ws.Cells(lastRow, fcStatusCol)).Value

    Dim priData() As Variant
    ReDim priData(1 To lastRow - 1, 1 To 1)

    Dim i As Long
    For i = 1 To lastRow - 1
        If lastRow = 2 Then
            priData(i, 1) = GetFCStatusPriority(CStr(statusData))
        Else
            priData(i, 1) = GetFCStatusPriority(CStr(statusData(i, 1)))
        End If
    Next i

    ws.Range(ws.Cells(2, priCol), ws.Cells(lastRow, priCol)).Value = priData

    Application.ScreenUpdating = True

End Sub

' ---- Step 5: highlight duplicate Encounter Numbers (visual aid) -----------------------------------------
'
' Applies red fill + white font to every row whose Encounter Number appears
' more than once. Purely cosmetic -- does not change row order or count.
Public Sub MarkDuplicateEncounters(ws As Worksheet)

    Dim encCol As Long
    encCol = FindEncounterCol(ws)
    If encCol = 0 Then Exit Sub

    Dim lastRow As Long
    lastRow = ws.Cells(ws.Rows.Count, encCol).End(xlUp).Row
    If lastRow < 3 Then Exit Sub   ' need at least 2 data rows for a duplicate

    Application.ScreenUpdating = False

    Dim encData As Variant
    encData = ws.Range(ws.Cells(2, encCol), ws.Cells(lastRow, encCol)).Value

    Dim counts As Object
    Set counts = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary")
    counts.CompareMode = vbTextCompare

    Dim i As Long
    Dim key As String
    For i = 1 To UBound(encData, 1)
        key = Trim(CStr(encData(i, 1)))
        If counts.Exists(key) Then
            counts(key) = counts(key) + 1
        Else
            counts(key) = 1
        End If
    Next i

    Dim dupRange As Range
    For i = 1 To UBound(encData, 1)
        key = Trim(CStr(encData(i, 1)))
        If counts(key) > 1 Then
            If dupRange Is Nothing Then
                Set dupRange = ws.Rows(i + 1)
            Else
                Set dupRange = Union(dupRange, ws.Rows(i + 1))
            End If
        End If
    Next i

    If Not dupRange Is Nothing Then
        dupRange.Interior.Color = RGB(255, 0, 0)
        dupRange.Font.Color = RGB(255, 255, 255)
    End If

    Application.ScreenUpdating = True

End Sub

' ---- Steps 6-8: automatic duplicate resolution -----------------------------------------
'
' For each Encounter Number with more than one row:
'   1. Compute the "plain" winner across ALL candidates: lowest
'      GetFCStatusPriority wins, ties broken by the larger FC ID (assumed to
'      be the more recently created one).
'   2. The narrow Inflight exception (Decision 4, 2026-07-29 conflict
'      resolution) only overrides the plain winner when BOTH hold:
'      a) at least one non-Inflight candidate in the group was created by an
'         ED/EDFC staff member (per the Config roster), AND
'      b) the winner that would result from setting Inflight rows aside has
'         priority <= 2 (i.e. Completed / Acknowledgement by other means).
'      When both hold, Inflight-created rows are set aside and the winner is
'      recomputed from the remaining (non-Inflight) candidates. Otherwise the
'      plain winner from step 1 stands -- this replaces the old, broader rule
'      that set Inflight rows aside whenever ANY non-Inflight row survived.
'   3. The winner is kept; every other row for that encounter is deleted.
'
' For each Encounter Number with exactly one row, that row is always kept --
' even if its priority is 99 (Voided/Deleted) -- but it is counted in
' voidedOnlyCount so MainMacro/BuildOutput can report it separately and
' exclude it from the denominator (per Q4).
'
' roster: Dictionary from Helpers.LoadStaffRoster (Staff Name -> Team).
'
' Returns False (and shows a MsgBox) if a required column is missing.
' On success, voidedOnlyCount, duplicateGroupsResolved, rowsRemoved,
' inflightExceptionApplied and inflightExceptionBlocked are filled in for the
' final summary dialog and the Methodology sheet.
Public Function ResolveDuplicateEncounters(ws As Worksheet, roster As Object, _
        ByRef voidedOnlyCount As Long, ByRef duplicateGroupsResolved As Long, _
        ByRef rowsRemoved As Long, ByRef inflightExceptionApplied As Long, _
        ByRef inflightExceptionBlocked As Long) As Boolean

    On Error GoTo ErrHandler

    voidedOnlyCount = 0
    duplicateGroupsResolved = 0
    rowsRemoved = 0
    inflightExceptionApplied = 0
    inflightExceptionBlocked = 0

    Dim encCol As Long, fcIdCol As Long, fcStatusCol As Long, createdByCol As Long
    encCol = FindEncounterCol(ws)
    fcIdCol = FindColByHeader(ws, "FC ID")
    fcStatusCol = FindColByHeader(ws, "FC Status")
    createdByCol = FindColByHeader(ws, "FC Created By")

    If encCol = 0 Or fcIdCol = 0 Or fcStatusCol = 0 Then
        MsgBox "Error: File A is missing one of 'Encounter Number', 'FC ID', or 'FC Status'." & vbNewLine & _
               "Check the FC Summary Report export.", vbExclamation, "Missing Column"
        ResolveDuplicateEncounters = False
        Exit Function
    End If
    ResolveDuplicateEncounters = True

    Dim lastRow As Long, lastCol As Long
    lastRow = ws.Cells(ws.Rows.Count, encCol).End(xlUp).Row
    If lastRow < 2 Then Exit Function
    lastCol = ws.Cells(1, ws.Columns.Count).End(xlToLeft).Column

    Application.ScreenUpdating = False
    Application.Calculation = xlCalculationManual

    Dim allData As Variant
    allData = ws.Range(ws.Cells(1, 1), ws.Cells(lastRow, lastCol)).Value

    ' --- Group data row indices (2..lastRow) by Encounter Number ---
    Dim groups As Object
    Set groups = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary")
    groups.CompareMode = vbTextCompare

    Dim i As Long
    Dim encVal As String
    For i = 2 To lastRow
        encVal = Trim(CStr(allData(i, encCol)))
        If Not groups.Exists(encVal) Then groups.Add encVal, New Collection
        groups(encVal).Add i
    Next i

    ' --- Decide which rows to keep ---
    Dim keepFlag() As Boolean
    ReDim keepFlag(1 To lastRow)
    keepFlag(1) = True   ' header row

    Dim k As Variant
    For Each k In groups.Keys
        Dim grp As Collection
        Set grp = groups(k)

        If grp.Count = 1 Then
            Dim soloIdx As Long
            soloIdx = grp(1)
            keepFlag(soloIdx) = True
            If GetFCStatusPriority(CStr(allData(soloIdx, fcStatusCol))) = 99 Then
                voidedOnlyCount = voidedOnlyCount + 1
            End If
        Else
            Dim n As Long
            n = grp.Count

            Dim candidates() As Long
            ReDim candidates(1 To n)
            Dim idx As Long
            For idx = 1 To n
                candidates(idx) = grp(idx)
            Next idx

            ' Classify each candidate's creator team, and note whether any
            ' non-Inflight candidate was created by ED/EDFC (Decision 4 guard a).
            Dim isInflight() As Boolean
            ReDim isInflight(1 To n)
            Dim inflightCount As Long
            inflightCount = 0
            Dim hasNonInflightED As Boolean
            hasNonInflightED = False
            For idx = 1 To n
                Dim createdBy As String
                createdBy = ""
                If createdByCol > 0 Then createdBy = CStr(allData(candidates(idx), createdByCol))
                Dim createdByTeam As String
                createdByTeam = GetStaffTeam(roster, createdBy)
                If createdByTeam = TEAM_INFLIGHT Then
                    isInflight(idx) = True
                    inflightCount = inflightCount + 1
                ElseIf createdByTeam = TEAM_ED_EDFC Then
                    hasNonInflightED = True
                End If
            Next idx

            ' Step 1: plain winner across ALL candidates (lowest priority,
            ' tie-break larger FC ID). This is the fallback whenever the
            ' narrow Inflight exception doesn't apply.
            Dim plainWinnerIdx As Long, plainWinnerPriority As Long
            Dim plainWinnerFCID As Variant
            Dim rowI As Long, pr As Long
            plainWinnerIdx = 0
            For idx = 1 To n
                rowI = candidates(idx)
                pr = GetFCStatusPriority(CStr(allData(rowI, fcStatusCol)))
                If plainWinnerIdx = 0 Then
                    plainWinnerIdx = idx
                    plainWinnerPriority = pr
                    plainWinnerFCID = allData(rowI, fcIdCol)
                ElseIf pr < plainWinnerPriority Then
                    plainWinnerIdx = idx
                    plainWinnerPriority = pr
                    plainWinnerFCID = allData(rowI, fcIdCol)
                ElseIf pr = plainWinnerPriority Then
                    If CompareFCID(allData(rowI, fcIdCol), plainWinnerFCID) > 0 Then
                        plainWinnerIdx = idx
                        plainWinnerFCID = allData(rowI, fcIdCol)
                    End If
                End If
            Next idx

            ' Step 2: consider the narrow Inflight exception (Decision 4).
            ' Guard (a): there is an Inflight row AND a non-Inflight candidate
            ' remains AND that non-Inflight side includes an ED/EDFC creator.
            Dim exceptionGuardA As Boolean
            exceptionGuardA = (inflightCount > 0 And inflightCount < n And hasNonInflightED)

            Dim winnerIdx As Long
            winnerIdx = plainWinnerIdx

            If exceptionGuardA Then
                ' Winner among non-Inflight candidates only.
                Dim excWinnerIdx As Long, excWinnerPriority As Long
                Dim excWinnerFCID As Variant
                excWinnerIdx = 0
                For idx = 1 To n
                    If Not isInflight(idx) Then
                        rowI = candidates(idx)
                        pr = GetFCStatusPriority(CStr(allData(rowI, fcStatusCol)))
                        If excWinnerIdx = 0 Then
                            excWinnerIdx = idx
                            excWinnerPriority = pr
                            excWinnerFCID = allData(rowI, fcIdCol)
                        ElseIf pr < excWinnerPriority Then
                            excWinnerIdx = idx
                            excWinnerPriority = pr
                            excWinnerFCID = allData(rowI, fcIdCol)
                        ElseIf pr = excWinnerPriority Then
                            If CompareFCID(allData(rowI, fcIdCol), excWinnerFCID) > 0 Then
                                excWinnerIdx = idx
                                excWinnerFCID = allData(rowI, fcIdCol)
                            End If
                        End If
                    End If
                Next idx

                ' Guard (b): the resulting winner must have priority <= 2.
                If excWinnerPriority <= 2 Then
                    winnerIdx = excWinnerIdx
                    inflightExceptionApplied = inflightExceptionApplied + 1
                Else
                    winnerIdx = plainWinnerIdx
                    inflightExceptionBlocked = inflightExceptionBlocked + 1
                End If
            End If

            For idx = 1 To n
                keepFlag(candidates(idx)) = (idx = winnerIdx)
            Next idx

            duplicateGroupsResolved = duplicateGroupsResolved + 1
            rowsRemoved = rowsRemoved + (n - 1)
        End If
    Next k

    ' --- Build the kept-rows array and write it back ---
    Dim keepCount As Long
    keepCount = 0
    For i = 1 To lastRow
        If keepFlag(i) Then keepCount = keepCount + 1
    Next i

    If keepCount < lastRow Then
        Dim outData() As Variant
        ReDim outData(1 To keepCount, 1 To lastCol)

        Dim outRow As Long, j As Long
        outRow = 0
        For i = 1 To lastRow
            If keepFlag(i) Then
                outRow = outRow + 1
                For j = 1 To lastCol
                    outData(outRow, j) = allData(i, j)
                Next j
            End If
        Next i

        ws.Range(ws.Cells(1, 1), ws.Cells(keepCount, lastCol)).Value = outData
        ws.Rows((keepCount + 1) & ":" & lastRow).Delete
    End If

    Application.StatusBar = "Duplicate resolution complete: " & duplicateGroupsResolved & _
        " encounter(s) had duplicates resolved (" & rowsRemoved & " row(s) removed); " & _
        voidedOnlyCount & " voided/deleted-only encounter(s) flagged for review."

    Application.Calculation = xlCalculationAutomatic
    Application.ScreenUpdating = True
    Exit Function

ErrHandler:
    Application.Calculation = xlCalculationAutomatic
    Application.ScreenUpdating = True
    MsgBox "Unexpected error during duplicate resolution:" & vbNewLine & _
           Err.Description & " (code " & Err.Number & ")", vbCritical, "Error"
    ResolveDuplicateEncounters = False

End Function

' Compares two FC ID values for the tie-break in ResolveDuplicateEncounters.
' Returns >0 if a is "later" (larger) than b, <0 if earlier, 0 if equal.
' Numeric FC IDs are compared numerically; anything else falls back to a
' text comparison (assumes same-length/zero-padded IDs sort correctly as
' strings -- confirm FC ID format once a real export is available).
Private Function CompareFCID(a As Variant, b As Variant) As Long
    Dim sa As String, sb As String
    sa = Trim(CStr(a))
    sb = Trim(CStr(b))

    If IsNumeric(sa) And IsNumeric(sb) Then
        If CDbl(sa) > CDbl(sb) Then
            CompareFCID = 1
        ElseIf CDbl(sa) < CDbl(sb) Then
            CompareFCID = -1
        Else
            CompareFCID = 0
        End If
    Else
        CompareFCID = StrComp(sa, sb, vbTextCompare)
    End If
End Function

' and the Generate button) from the current selections. The m_validX flags hold
' ONLY header validity (set by HandleSlotPick); the duplicate conflict is tracked
' locally here so it can never leave a slot stuck invalid after the conflict is

' HAS been selected, though, it must be header-valid before Generate enables --
' a chosen-but-invalid File B is a mistake worth blocking on, not silently

Private Sub UpdateValidationStatus()
    Dim isDuplicate As Boolean
    isDuplicate = False

    ' Clear warning
    m_lblWarning.caption = ""
    m_lblWarning.Visible = False

    ' Duplicate file check
    If Not SelectedFileA Is Nothing And Not SelectedFileB Is Nothing Then
        If UCase(SelectedFileA.FullName) = UCase(SelectedFileB.FullName) Then isDuplicate = True
    End If

    If isDuplicate Then
        m_lblWarning.caption = "Same file selected for both File A and File B!"

        m_lblFileBStatus.caption = "Valid"
        m_lblFileBStatus.ForeColor = RGB(0, 128, 0)

            m_lblWarning.caption = "File B's 'Missed FC' column is entirely blank." & vbNewLine & _
                "Re-export with the Missed FC indicator ticked, or leave File B unselected " & _
                "and enter the Missed FC count manually below (dashboard workaround)."
            m_lblWarning.Visible = True
        End If
    End If

    ' File B is optional: "ready" means either not selected at all, or selected
    ' and header-valid.
    Dim fileBReady As Boolean
    fileBReady = (SelectedFileB Is Nothing) Or m_validB

    ' Enable Generate once File A is valid, File B (if present) is valid, and
    ' the two files don't conflict.
    m_btnGenerate.Enabled = (m_validA And fileBReady And Not isDuplicate)

                   m_lblFileAName, m_lblFileAStatus, m_validA

    HandleSlotPick SelectedFileB, "Select File B -- Inflight Missed FC Report", "INFLIGHT_MISSED", _
                   m_lblFileBName, m_lblFileBStatus, m_validB

' Shared Browse handler for both slots. Picks a file, closes the slot's previous
' workbook (UNLESS the user re-picked the same file -- Workbooks.Open returns the
' already-open instance, so closing it would invalidate the new reference and
' crash on wb.Name), validates headers, updates the file/status labels, then
' recomputes cross-slot state.
Private Sub HandleSlotPick(ByRef slotWb As Workbook, title As String, fileType As String, _
                           lblFile As MSForms.Label, lblStatus As MSForms.Label, _
                           ByRef validFlag As Boolean)
    Dim wb As Workbook
    Set wb = PickFileWithFolder(title)
    If wb Is Nothing Then Exit Sub      ' user cancelled the dialog -- keep current selection

    ' Release the slot's previous workbook, unless the user re-picked the same file
    ' (Workbooks.Open returns the already-open instance, so closing it would invalidate wb).
    If Not (slotWb Is wb) Then CloseSlotWorkbook slotWb

    Set slotWb = wb
    lblFile.caption = wb.Name
    If ValidateFileHeaders(wb, fileType) Then
        validFlag = True
        lblStatus.caption = "Valid"
        lblStatus.ForeColor = RGB(0, 128, 0)
    Else
        validFlag = False
        lblStatus.caption = "Invalid"
        lblStatus.ForeColor = RGB(255, 0, 0)
    End If

    UpdateValidationStatus

' Closes a slot's workbook only if the OTHER slot does not still reference the
' same workbook object. (When the same file is chosen for both slots,
' Workbooks.Open hands back one shared instance; closing it for one slot would
' otherwise invalidate the other and crash on later access.)
Private Sub CloseSlotWorkbook(wbToClose As Workbook)
    If wbToClose Is Nothing Then Exit Sub
    Dim refs As Long
    If SelectedFileA Is wbToClose Then refs = refs + 1
    If SelectedFileB Is wbToClose Then refs = refs + 1
    If refs <= 1 Then
        On Error Resume Next
        wbToClose.Close SaveChanges:=False

    End If

    Dim txt As String

    If txt = "" Then txt = "0"

    If Not IsNumeric(txt) Or CDbl(txt) < 0 Or CDbl(txt) <> Int(CDbl(txt)) Then
        MsgBox "Missed FC count (dashboard workaround) must be a whole number of 0 or more.", _
               vbExclamation, "Invalid Missed FC Count"
        Exit Sub
    End If

    MissedFCManualCount = CLng(txt)
    Cancelled = False
    Me.Hide
End Sub

Private Sub m_btnCancel_Click()
    Cancelled = True
    ' Close opened files
    On Error Resume Next
    If Not SelectedFileA Is Nothing Then SelectedFileA.Close SaveChanges:=False
    If Not SelectedFileB Is Nothing Then SelectedFileB.Close SaveChanges:=False
    On Error GoTo 0
    Me.Hide
End Sub

    If CloseMode = vbFormControlMenu Then
        Cancel = 1
        m_btnCancel_Click
    End If

5	' FilterFileA.bas
6	'
7	' File A = FC Summary Report. This module covers the early cleaning
8	' steps that don't depend on the staff roster or any other file:
9	'
10	'   Step 1 -- FilterFCMode:     keep only Financial Counselling rows
11	'                                (drops Shopper mode and anything else)
12	'   Step 2 -- DeleteCancelledAdmissions: drop Admission Status = "Cancelled"
13	'
14	' Later steps (sort/highlight/dedup/EM-EL split) live in
15	' DeduplicateEncounters.bas and are orchestrated from MainMacro.
16	'
17	' Load-filter-write strategy: reads the sheet once into a Variant array,
18	' compacts matching rows in memory, writes back in one bulk operation.
19	' ============================================================
20	
21	Private Const FC_MODE_AH       As String = "Financial Counselling - AH"
22	Private Const FC_MODE_DOWNTIME As String = "Financial Counselling - Downtime"
23	
24	Private Const ADM_CANCELLED As String = "Cancelled"

26	' Step 1 -- keeps only rows where FC Mode is "Financial Counselling - AH" or
27	' "Financial Counselling - Downtime". Removes Shopper mode and any other
28	' non-FC mode rows.
29	Public Function FilterFCMode(ws As Worksheet) As Boolean
30	
31	    On Error GoTo ErrHandler
32	
33	    Dim modeCol As Long
34	    modeCol = FindColByHeader(ws, "FC Mode")
35	    If modeCol = 0 Then
36	        MsgBox "Error: File A is missing the 'FC Mode' column." & vbNewLine & _
37	               "Check the FC Summary Report export.", vbExclamation, "Missing Column"
38	        FilterFCMode = False
39	        Exit Function
40	    End If
41	    FilterFCMode = True
42	
43	    Dim encCol As Long
44	    encCol = FindEncounterCol(ws)
45	
46	    Dim lastRow As Long, lastCol As Long
47	    If encCol > 0 Then
48	        lastRow = ws.Cells(ws.Rows.Count, encCol).End(xlUp).Row
49	    Else
50	        lastRow = ws.Cells(ws.Rows.Count, modeCol).End(xlUp).Row
51	    End If
52	    If lastRow < 2 Then Exit Function
53	    lastCol = ws.Cells(1, ws.Columns.Count).End(xlToLeft).Column
54	
55	    Application.ScreenUpdating = False
56	    Application.Calculation = xlCalculationManual
57	
58	    ' --- Step 1: Load entire working sheet into memory (one read) ---
59	    Dim allData As Variant
60	    allData = ws.Range(ws.Cells(1, 1), ws.Cells(lastRow, lastCol)).Value

Attribute VB_Name = "FilterFileA"
Option Explicit

' ============================================================
' FilterFileA.bas
'
' File A = FC Summary Report. This module covers the early cleaning
' steps that don't depend on the staff roster or any other file:
'
'   Step 1 -- FilterFCMode:     keep only Financial Counselling rows
'                                (drops Shopper mode and anything else)
'   Step 2 -- DeleteCancelledAdmissions: drop Admission Status = "Cancelled"
'
' Later steps (sort/highlight/dedup/EM-EL split) live in
' DeduplicateEncounters.bas and are orchestrated from MainMacro.
'
' Load-filter-write strategy: reads the sheet once into a Variant array,
' compacts matching rows in memory, writes back in one bulk operation.
' ============================================================

Private Const FC_MODE_AH       As String = "Financial Counselling - AH"
Private Const FC_MODE_DOWNTIME As String = "Financial Counselling - Downtime"

Private Const ADM_CANCELLED As String = "Cancelled"

' Step 1 -- keeps only rows where FC Mode is "Financial Counselling - AH" or
' "Financial Counselling - Downtime". Removes Shopper mode and any other
' non-FC mode rows.
Public Function FilterFCMode(ws As Worksheet) As Boolean

    On Error GoTo ErrHandler

    Dim modeCol As Long
    modeCol = FindColByHeader(ws, "FC Mode")
    If modeCol = 0 Then
        MsgBox "Error: File A is missing the 'FC Mode' column." & vbNewLine & _
               "Check the FC Summary Report export.", vbExclamation, "Missing Column"
        FilterFCMode = False
        Exit Function
    End If
    FilterFCMode = True

    Dim encCol As Long
    encCol = FindEncounterCol(ws)

    Dim lastRow As Long, lastCol As Long
    If encCol > 0 Then
        lastRow = ws.Cells(ws.Rows.Count, encCol).End(xlUp).Row
    Else
        lastRow = ws.Cells(ws.Rows.Count, modeCol).End(xlUp).Row
    End If
    If lastRow < 2 Then Exit Function
    lastCol = ws.Cells(1, ws.Columns.Count).End(xlToLeft).Column

    Application.ScreenUpdating = False
    Application.Calculation = xlCalculationManual

    ' --- Step 1: Load entire working sheet into memory (one read) ---
    Dim allData As Variant
    allData = ws.Range(ws.Cells(1, 1), ws.Cells(lastRow, lastCol)).Value

    ' --- Step 2: Count rows with an allowed FC Mode ---
    ' Both sides run through NormalizeDashesAndSpaces: the .docx guide writes
    ' "Financial Counselling - AH" with an EN DASH, so a real export using
    ' that character (or an em dash) must still match the plain-hyphen constants.
    Dim keepCount As Long
    Dim i As Long
    Dim modeVal As String
    Dim modeAHNorm As String, modeDowntimeNorm As String
    modeAHNorm = UCase(NormalizeDashesAndSpaces(FC_MODE_AH))
    modeDowntimeNorm = UCase(NormalizeDashesAndSpaces(FC_MODE_DOWNTIME))
    For i = 2 To lastRow
        modeVal = UCase(NormalizeDashesAndSpaces(CStr(allData(i, modeCol))))
        If modeVal = modeAHNorm Or modeVal = modeDowntimeNorm Then
            keepCount = keepCount + 1
        End If
    Next i

    If keepCount = 0 Then
        ws.Range(ws.Cells(2, 1), ws.Cells(lastRow, lastCol)).ClearContents
        Application.Calculation = xlCalculationAutomatic
        Application.ScreenUpdating = True
        MsgBox "No Financial Counselling rows found after the FC Mode filter." & vbNewLine & _
               "Check the FC Summary Report export.", vbExclamation, "No Data"
        FilterFCMode = False
        Exit Function
    End If

    ' --- Step 3: Build a compacted array of only the matching rows ---
    Dim filtData() As Variant
    ReDim filtData(1 To keepCount, 1 To lastCol)

    Dim outRow As Long, j As Long
    For i = 2 To lastRow
        modeVal = UCase(NormalizeDashesAndSpaces(CStr(allData(i, modeCol))))
        If modeVal = modeAHNorm Or modeVal = modeDowntimeNorm Then
            outRow = outRow + 1
            For j = 1 To lastCol
                filtData(outRow, j) = allData(i, j)
            Next j
        End If
    Next i

    ' --- Step 4: Write filtered rows back starting at row 2 (one write) ---
    ws.Range(ws.Cells(2, 1), ws.Cells(1 + keepCount, lastCol)).Value = filtData

    ' --- Step 5: Delete the now-empty tail rows below the new last data row ---
    Dim newLastRow As Long
    newLastRow = 1 + keepCount
    If newLastRow < lastRow Then
        ws.Rows((newLastRow + 1) & ":" & lastRow).Delete
    End If

    Application.StatusBar = "FC Mode filter complete: kept " & keepCount & " rows."
    Application.Calculation = xlCalculationAutomatic
    Application.ScreenUpdating = True
    Exit Function

ErrHandler:
    Application.Calculation = xlCalculationAutomatic
    Application.ScreenUpdating = True
    MsgBox "Unexpected error during FC Mode filter:" & vbNewLine & _
           Err.Description & " (code " & Err.Number & ")", vbCritical, "Error"
    FilterFCMode = False

End Function

' Step 2 -- deletes rows where Admission Status = "Cancelled".
Public Function DeleteCancelledAdmissions(ws As Worksheet) As Boolean

    On Error GoTo ErrHandler

    Dim admStatCol As Long
    admStatCol = FindColByHeader(ws, "Admission Status")
    If admStatCol = 0 Then
        MsgBox "Error: File A is missing the 'Admission Status' column." & vbNewLine & _
               "Check the FC Summary Report export.", vbExclamation, "Missing Column"
        DeleteCancelledAdmissions = False
        Exit Function
    End If
    DeleteCancelledAdmissions = True

    Dim encCol As Long
    encCol = FindEncounterCol(ws)

    Dim lastRow As Long, lastCol As Long
    If encCol > 0 Then
        lastRow = ws.Cells(ws.Rows.Count, encCol).End(xlUp).Row
    Else
        lastRow = ws.Cells(ws.Rows.Count, admStatCol).End(xlUp).Row
    End If
    If lastRow < 2 Then Exit Function
    lastCol = ws.Cells(1, ws.Columns.Count).End(xlToLeft).Column

    Application.ScreenUpdating = False
    Application.Calculation = xlCalculationManual

    ' --- Step 1: Load entire working sheet into memory (one read) ---
    Dim allData As Variant
    allData = ws.Range(ws.Cells(1, 1), ws.Cells(lastRow, lastCol)).Value

    ' --- Step 2: Count rows whose Admission Status is NOT "Cancelled" ---
    Dim keepCount As Long
    Dim i As Long
    For i = 2 To lastRow
        If UCase(Trim(CStr(allData(i, admStatCol)))) <> UCase(ADM_CANCELLED) Then
            keepCount = keepCount + 1
        End If
    Next i

    If keepCount = lastRow - 1 Then
        ' Nothing to remove
        Application.Calculation = xlCalculationAutomatic
        Application.ScreenUpdating = True
        Application.StatusBar = "Cancelled-admission filter complete: no Cancelled rows found."
        Exit Function
    End If

    If keepCount = 0 Then
        ws.Range(ws.Cells(2, 1), ws.Cells(lastRow, lastCol)).ClearContents
        Application.Calculation = xlCalculationAutomatic
        Application.ScreenUpdating = True
        MsgBox "All rows have Admission Status = 'Cancelled'." & vbNewLine & _
               "Check the FC Summary Report export.", vbExclamation, "No Data"
        DeleteCancelledAdmissions = False
        Exit Function
    End If

    ' --- Step 3: Build a compacted array of only the non-Cancelled rows ---
    Dim filtData() As Variant
    ReDim filtData(1 To keepCount, 1 To lastCol)

    Dim outRow As Long, j As Long
    For i = 2 To lastRow
        If UCase(Trim(CStr(allData(i, admStatCol)))) <> UCase(ADM_CANCELLED) Then
            outRow = outRow + 1
            For j = 1 To lastCol
                filtData(outRow, j) = allData(i, j)
            Next j
        End If
    Next i

    ' --- Step 4: Write filtered rows back starting at row 2 (one write) ---
    ws.Range(ws.Cells(2, 1), ws.Cells(1 + keepCount, lastCol)).Value = filtData

    ' --- Step 5: Delete the now-empty tail rows below the new last data row ---
    Dim newLastRow As Long
    newLastRow = 1 + keepCount
    If newLastRow < lastRow Then
        ws.Rows((newLastRow + 1) & ":" & lastRow).Delete
    End If

    Application.StatusBar = "Cancelled-admission filter complete: removed " & (lastRow - 1 - keepCount) & " row(s)."
    Application.Calculation = xlCalculationAutomatic
    Application.ScreenUpdating = True
    Exit Function

ErrHandler:
    Application.Calculation = xlCalculationAutomatic
    Application.ScreenUpdating = True
    MsgBox "Unexpected error during Cancelled-admission filter:" & vbNewLine & _
           Err.Description & " (code " & Err.Number & ")", vbCritical, "Error"
    DeleteCancelledAdmissions = False

End Function

# FC Completion Report -- VBA Code Progress

This tracks what's been implemented so far vs. what's still waiting on
answers from colleagues (see `docs/FC_Completion_Report_Process_Flow_for_Review.md`
and the "Outstanding blanks" list in `CLAUDE.md`).

Module files live in the project root (`*.bas`) and are mirrored into
`FCCompletion_All_Modules.txt` (the staff-facing paste-into-VBA-editor
deliverable, regenerated via `regen_modules.ps1`).

**Compile status:** `FCCompletion_All_Modules.txt` (Helpers, FilterFileA,
FilterFileB, DeduplicateEncounters, BuildOutput, MainMacro, FilePickerForm,
ProgressForm) -- **needs user re-compile** after the 2026-07-29 conflict
resolution (see "2026-07-29 conflict resolution" section below -- every
module except ProgressForm.bas changed). Previous modules compiled cleanly
as of 2026-06-10; not re-verified since.

---

## Done

### Helpers.bas
- `FindColByHeader`, `NormHeader` -- header-based column lookup, copied
  verbatim from the MFC macro.
- `FindEncounterCol` -- tries "Encounter Number" (File A) then "Encounter No"
  (File B), since the two eFC exports label this column differently.
- `ValidateFileHeaders` -- FilePickerForm validation for `FC_SUMMARY` (File A)
  and `INFLIGHT_MISSED` (File B).
- `IsMissedFCColumnBlank` -- detects the File B "Missed FC column entirely
  blank" workaround case from CLAUDE.md.
- `CreateConfigSheet` / `LoadStaffRoster` / `GetStaffTeam` -- builds and reads
  a "Staff Name -> Team" roster table on a `Config` sheet. Teams: ED/EDFC,
  Inflight, NCID AO, ICH PSO, Admin/Managers, Others (default for anyone not
  listed).

### ProgressForm.bas
Reused as-is from the MFC macro, caption updated to "FC Completion Report --
Generating".

### FilePickerForm.bas
2-slot dashboard (File A: FC Summary Report, File B: Inflight Missed FC
Report) -- Browse/status per slot, duplicate-file check, Missed-FC-blank
warning, Generate enabled only when both slots are valid.

**Note:** status indicators use plain ASCII ("Valid" / "Invalid" / "O" / "X
Same file") instead of the `(check)/(cross)/(circle)/(warning)` symbols used
in the MFC form. CLAUDE.md requires `FCCompletion_All_Modules.txt` to stay in
clean ASCII (the MFC project has had repeated Unicode-corruption issues
needing `fix_qmarks.ps1`-style cleanup) -- using ASCII from the start avoids
that for this project. Flag if you'd prefer the Unicode symbols anyway.

### FilterFileA.bas (Steps 1-2)
- `FilterFCMode` -- keep only "Financial Counselling - AH" /
  "Financial Counselling - Downtime".
- `DeleteCancelledAdmissions` -- drop Admission Status = "Cancelled".

### FilterFileB.bas (Steps 1-4 of the process flow doc)
- `FilterFCModeIfPresent` -- no-op if File B has no "FC Mode" column
  (CLAUDE.md blank #2).
- `KeepOnlyMissedFC` -- keep only Missed FC = "Yes".
- `DeleteCancelledOrPlanned` -- drop Admission Status = "Cancelled"/"Planned".
- `FlagEDVWDischarges` -- adds an informational "EDVW Discharge" column
  (Point Of Care = "TTSH Virtual Ward" + Accommodation Code = "EDVW"). Rows
  are NOT removed -- this is a label only, per the process flow doc's current
  proposal for Q5.

### DeduplicateEncounters.bas (Steps 3, 5-8)
- `GetFCStatusPriority` -- the 10-level priority table from the process flow
  doc (Q2).
- `AddPriorityColumn` -- writes a "PRIORITISE" column.
- `MarkDuplicateEncounters` -- highlights duplicate Encounter Numbers in red
  (visual aid).
- `ResolveDuplicateEncounters` -- automatically picks one row per Encounter
  Number (lowest priority wins, tie-break by larger FC ID), applies the
  Inflight-creator exception (Q3) via the Config roster, deletes the rest, and
  counts Voided/Deleted-only encounters (Q4) for the final report.

**Note (2026-06-18):** Q2-Q4 (and all other process flow questions) are now
confirmed -- see "Process flow confirmation" section below. The Inflight
exception is driven entirely by the `Config` roster; with an empty roster
`GetStaffTeam` returns "Others" for everyone, so the exception is inert until
real staff names are filled in.

---

## Process flow confirmation (2026-06-18)

All 8 questions from `docs/FC_Completion_Report_Process_Flow_for_Review.md`
have been confirmed by the user. The process flow doc is now the authoritative
spec -- its rules should be implemented as written.

| Q# | Decision |
|---|---|
| Q1 | EM/EL split by Admission Type only -- no Point of Care condition |
| Q2 | FC Status priority order is correct as written |
| Q3 | Inflight-created FC set aside in favour of non-Inflight (confirmed) |
| Q4 | Voided/Deleted-only encounters fully excluded from denominator |
| Q5 | EDVW discharges count as missed FC (flagged, not excluded) |
| Q6 | Team set confirmed: ED/EDFC, Inflight, NCID AO, ICH PSO, Admin/Managers, Others |
| Q7 | Fall back to FC Created By when Latest CCF Creation User is blank, but **highlight** those rows |
| Q8 | Conservative principle confirmed -- ambiguous cases default to not completed |

---

## 2026-07-29 conflict resolution

Resolved five spec conflicts between "Guide to monthly processing of report
3.docx" (the authoritative process guide) and
`docs/FC_Completion_Report_Process_Flow_for_Review.md`, which had silently
diverged from the guide by the time Q1-Q8 were confirmed 2026-06-18. Also
made File B optional and fixed a latent en-dash comparison bug. Every module
except `ProgressForm.bas` changed; the merged deliverable was regenerated
from the edited `.bas` files.

**Decision 1 -- EM/EL split now requires Point of Care (Q1 revised).**
- `Helpers.bas`: `CreateConfigSheet` adds a "NCID EL Point of Care" list
  (column D, ships empty with a header comment) alongside the staff roster.
  New `LoadNCIDPointOfCareList` returns a `vbTextCompare` Dictionary.
- `BuildOutput.bas`: `BuildOutputWorkbook` now computes a per-row `secArr()`
  section classification (SEC_EM / SEC_EL / 0) in its main pass -- an
  Elective Inpatient row only gets SEC_EL if its Point of Care matches the
  Config list. `WriteFilteredFileASheet` was changed to filter by this
  pre-computed array instead of re-deriving from Admission Type text, so the
  EL sheet actually honours the gate. If the list is empty, `elComputed =
  False`: a MsgBox warns the user, the EL sheet/summary block/methodology
  text are skipped, and EM is still produced normally. PoC-mismatched
  Elective rows are counted in a new `elPocExcluded` footnote, not silently
  dropped.

**Decision 2 -- priority 99 means Voided/Deleted only.**
- `DeduplicateEncounters.bas`: `GetFCStatusPriority` now matches "VOID" /
  "DELET" substrings (case-insensitive) for 99; everything else not in the
  six explicit statuses is 98 (was: statuses 7/8/9 for Draft variants, else
  99 for anything unrecognised). 98 stays IN the denominator; only 99 is
  excluded.
- `BuildOutput.bas`: the main stats pass collects distinct FC Status text
  landing on priority 98 into an `unrecognisedStatuses` Dictionary, printed
  as a warning block on the Summary sheet.

**Decision 3 -- five colour bands, Drafts split out.**
- `BuildOutput.bas`: `WriteSummaryBlock` rewritten with Green (1-2) / Pink
  (3) / Light Green (4-5) / Orange (6) / White-none-Draft (98) / Grey
  (missed), plus a "Not completed (total)" subtotal (Orange + Draft +
  Missed) and a visible "Total" row with a red MISMATCH flag if the bands
  don't sum to the denominator. Counter variables renamed to match the new
  bands (`pinkCt`, `ltGreenCt`, `orangeCt`, `draftCt` replace the old
  `lgCt`/`orgCt`/`redCt`).

**Decision 4 -- narrowed Inflight duplicate exception.**
- `DeduplicateEncounters.bas`: `ResolveDuplicateEncounters` now computes a
  "plain" winner (lowest priority, tie-break larger FC ID) across ALL
  candidates first. The Inflight exception only overrides it when a non-
  Inflight ED/EDFC-created candidate is present AND the winner picked from
  non-Inflight candidates has priority <= 2; otherwise the plain winner
  stands. Two new `ByRef` out-params, `inflightExceptionApplied` and
  `inflightExceptionBlocked`, are threaded through `MainMacro.bas` into the
  final MsgBox and the Methodology sheet.

**Decision 5 -- File B is now optional.**
- `FilePickerForm.bas`: File B slot is optional (label updated); Generate
  enables once File A is valid (File B, if selected, must still be header-
  valid). Added a "Missed FC count (dashboard workaround)" text box
  (default 0), validated as a non-negative integer on Generate, exposed as
  `Public MissedFCManualCount`.
- `MainMacro.bas`: rewritten to use a running `stepNum`/`totalSteps` counter
  (8 base steps + 4 more if File B present) instead of a hardcoded constant;
  File B's four cleaning steps are skipped entirely when absent; `wbB.Close`
  is guarded by `hasFileB`.
- `BuildOutput.bas`: `BuildOutputWorkbook` accepts `missedFCManualCount`
  instead of assuming `fileBws` is always present. When File B is absent,
  the manual count is attributed entirely to EM (documented in the
  Methodology sheet -- the dashboard workaround doesn't distinguish
  Elective/NCID AO cases) and the "Missed FC" sheet is skipped.

**Also fixed -- en dash bug (not a conflict, a latent crash).**
- `Helpers.bas`: new `NormalizeDashesAndSpaces` normalises `Chr(150)` /
  `ChrW(8211)` (en dash) and `ChrW(8212)` (em dash) to a plain hyphen and
  collapses whitespace, built via `ChrW()` so the source stays ASCII.
  `FilterFileA.FilterFCMode`, `FilterFileB.FilterFCModeIfPresent`, and
  `DeduplicateEncounters.GetFCStatusPriority` now run both sides of their
  FC Mode / FC Status comparisons through it -- the guide's sample data uses
  an en dash ("Financial Counselling <U+2013> AH"), which would otherwise
  make `FilterFCMode` delete every row.

Docs updated to match: `CLAUDE.md` (priority table detail, colour table
Draft/White row, outstanding blanks #6, File B optionality) and
`docs/FC_Completion_Report_Process_Flow_for_Review.md` (priority table,
Section 2 steps 6 and 9, Section 3/4 File B optionality and Config PoC list,
Section 5A five-band table, Section 7 Q1/Q3 revision notes).

---

### BuildOutput.bas (2026-06-18 -- major expansion)
- `BuildOutputWorkbook` -- main orchestrator: reads deduplicated File A,
  splits by Admission Type into EM/EL, computes all stats in one pass,
  creates output workbook with 6 sheets, saves via FileDialog.
- EM/EL split (process flow Step 9): purely by Admission Type (Q1 confirmed).

- `WriteMethodologySheet` -- plain-language explanation of every rule with

- `HighlightCCFFallbackRows` -- highlights yellow any row where Latest CCF

- `WriteMissedFCSheet` -- copies cleaned File B data as-is.
- Output file naming: `FCReportSummary_<MonthName><Year>.xlsx` (per 2026-06-11
  addendum), suggested via SaveAs dialog.

### MainMacro.bas (2026-06-18 -- new module)
- `GenerateFCCompletionReport` -- entry point (Alt+F8). Full pipeline:

' ---- File picking (used by one-off Alt+F8 utilities) ----------------------------------

' Opens a workbook via Application.FileDialog. Returns Nothing if the user
' cancels. Unlike FilePickerForm's PickFileWithFolder (private to that form),
' this is reusable by standalone Alt+F8 subs like SuggestTeamsFromPointOfCare

Public Function PickFile(title As String) As Workbook
    Dim fd As FileDialog

    fd.Filters.Clear
    fd.Filters.Add "Excel Files", "*.xlsx; *.xlsm; *.xls"

    If fd.Show = -1 Then
        Set PickFile = Workbooks.Open(fd.SelectedItems(1))
    Else
        Set PickFile = Nothing
    End If
End Function
